title: Summer Intern - User Experience (UX)
note: UX for security and access products; no visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: UX design and research intern on Allegion's software products team.
facts.duties: Helps make wireframes, flows and prototypes, run usability tests and interviews, and document UI components in Figma.
facts.requirements: Interaction Design, HCI or CS student who knows the basics of UX deliverables, user research, IA and accessibility. A portfolio is preferred.
